attributes.protocol: Participants with RNA-seq and monoallelic disorders, panels of up to 500 genes; rare variants with SpliceAI2 > 0.25 in panel genes are prioritised and checked in RNA-seq against 20 pooled controls lacking the variant (sashimi plots, Extended Data Fig. 5).

attributes.source_locator: Main 'Contribution to rare genetic disease' paragraph 4; Fig. 4h,i; Extended Data Fig. 5
